name: GridMesh
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,spacingX,spacingY,[customSequenceX],[customSequenceY],LET(xCoor, CHOOSECOLS(vertices, 1), yCoor, CHOOSECOLS(vertices, 2), xMax, MAX(xCoor), xMin, MIN(xCoor), yMax, MAX(yCoor), yMin, MIN(yCoor), numX, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceX), INT((xMax - xMin) / spacingX) + 1, ROWS(customSequenceX)), actualSpacingX, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceX), (xMax - xMin) / (numX - 1), 1), sequenceX, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceX), SEQUENCE(numX, 1, xMin, actualSpacingX), customSequenceX), numY, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceY), INT((yMax - yMin) / spacingY) + 1, ROWS(customSequenceY)), actualSpacingY, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceY), (yMax - yMin) / (numY - 1), 1), sequenceY, IF(ISOMITTED(customSequenceY), SEQUENCE(numY, 1, yMin, actualSpacingY), customSequenceY), quadsArr, DROP(REDUCE(0, SEQUENCE(numX - 1), LAMBDA(acc,i, VSTACK(acc, MAP(SEQUENCE(numY - 1), LAMBDA(j, LET(xp, INDEX(sequenceX, i), xq, INDEX(sequenceX, i + 1), yp, INDEX(sequenceY, j), yq, INDEX(sequenceY, j + 1), ptA, HSTACK(xp, yp), ptB, HSTACK(xq, yp), ptC, HSTACK(xq, yq), ptD, HSTACK(xp, yq), quad, VSTACK(ptA, ptB, ptC, ptD), ARRAYTOTEXT(quad, 1))))))), 1), quadsArrFiltered, DROP(REDUCE(0, quadsArr, LAMBDA(acc,quadText, LET(quad, VALUE({ref}TextToArray(quadText)), IF({ref}IsPolysIntersect(quad, vertices), IF({ref}isPolyAInPolyB(quad, vertices), VSTACK(acc, quadText), LET(overlappedText, {ref}OverlappedPolygons(quad, vertices), overlappedPoly, VALUE({ref}TextToArray(overlappedText)), refinedOverlappedPoly, IF(ROWS(overlappedPoly) > 4, {ref}SplitPolyByLine(overlappedPoly, INDEX(overlappedPoly, 1, 1), INDEX(overlappedPoly, 1, 2), INDEX(overlappedPoly, 4, 1), INDEX(overlappedPoly, 4, 2)), overlappedText), IF(ISNA(overlappedText), acc, VSTACK(acc, refinedOverlappedPoly)))), acc)))), 1), quadsArrFiltered))
comment: Meshes a polygon into grid cells. vertices is an n×2 array of (x, y) rows in order; the last vertex connects to the first. spacingX and spacingY set the step. The grid runs from the minimum coordinate to the maximum. customSequenceX and customSequenceY are optional columns of exact grid coordinates. A cell inside the polygon is kept. A partial overlap is replaced by the overlap polygon. An overlap of more than four vertices is split from its first vertex to its fourth. Each result row is a strict ARRAYTOTEXT of (x, y) rows. A spacing of 0 returns #DIV/0!. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
